name: Draconic Evolution Guide
landing_text: A field guide to Draconic Evolution on Minecraft 26.1.2.$(br2)This book was written for the unofficial 26.1.2 port. Some features are untested here, so read $(l:this_port/whats_different)What's different in this port$(/l) before you build anything big.$(br2)Recipes for every item are also in JEI. The same guide opens as a wiki-style GuideME page: hold G while hovering a Draconic Evolution item.
